episode_reviews.notes: Reviewed all98 saved video frames and the full786-control trace. The robot deliberately grasps ketchup, carries it to the left drainer compartment and eventually releases it after a long final-release approach. It then approaches the shifted blue alphabet-soup can, retries its grasp, lifts and carries the intended can to the right compartment, and releases it. Native milestones347/780 are followed by the inherited release-and-exact-base-support holds354/786. Ketchup is stationary throughout the second task from control541 onward (maximum displacement5.1e-17m), remains nativeIn, and stays released and base-supported for the final437 controls. Soup has no gripper contact from778, and exact native bottom support holds782-786. Both opposite-compartment predicates stay false. The uninstructed BBQ bottle is displaced during the soup pickup, but no earlier requested placement or drainer is disturbed and no substitute object is credited. The inherited five-control support rule is not a velocity-based settlement guarantee.
